arStrings.szText: While {c_important}Wrath{/c} Charm equipped, spending {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} Primary Resource creates an explosion that deals {c_number}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix_Value_1]{/c} damage of the type with the highest bonus to all surrounding enemies.
